name: Bangumi
restrictedUse: do not publicly republish user comment text
do not store private or login-only data in the repository
do not commit raw source exports
licenseNotes: Review source terms before expanding use. Treat user-generated comments as analysis input only unless separately permitted.
rateLimitNotes: Use documented API behavior and conservative local throttling.

name: AniList
restrictedUse: do not commit raw source exports
do not assume user reviews can be republished
licenseNotes: Review API and site terms before using large exports.
rateLimitNotes: Use GraphQL pagination and conservative local throttling.

name: VNDB
restrictedUse: do not commit raw source exports
do not treat tags as final Baihepailei ratings
licenseNotes: Review VNDB API and data terms before publication.
rateLimitNotes: Respect documented limits and cache locally.

name: Wikidata
restrictedUse: do not assume Wikidata relations are complete or final
licenseNotes: Structured data is intended for reuse, but attribution and source links are still useful for traceability.
rateLimitNotes: Prefer cached SPARQL/entity results for repeat runs.

name: Wikipedia
restrictedUse: do not copy long article text into Baihepailei records
do not commit raw extracted pages
licenseNotes: Follow source license requirements if text is reused. Prefer links and derived metadata.

name: Manual curation
restrictedUse: do not store private notes in public fields
do not commit local-only raw notes
licenseNotes: Manual entries should still cite source links when based on external material.
